scenario: A curator is arranging exactly seven sculptures — Fountain, Garland, Helix, Ibis, Juno, Kestrel, and Lotus — in a gallery that consists of six numbered display platforms, numbered 1 through 6 from the entrance to the back wall. Each platform holds at least one sculpture, and no platform holds more than two. Platforms 1 and 2 are in the North wing; platforms 3 and 4 are in the Center wing; platforms 5 and 6 are in the South wing. The arrangement must meet the following conditions: Fountain is displayed on a lower-numbered platform than Garland. Helix is displayed in the Center wing. Ibis is displayed on a higher-numbered platform than Juno. Juno and Kestrel are not displayed in the same wing. Lotus is displayed on platform 1. If Garland is displayed in the North wing, then Kestrel is displayed in the South wing. Fountain and Helix are not displayed on adjacent platforms.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate list of the sculptures displayed on platforms 1 through 6, with two sculptures listed where a platform holds two?

choices.label: A
choices.text: 1: Lotus, Fountain; 2: Juno; 3: Helix; 4: Kestrel; 5: Garland; 6: Ibis

choices.label: B
choices.text: 1: Lotus; 2: Fountain; 3: Helix, Garland; 4: Juno; 5: Kestrel; 6: Ibis

choices.label: C
choices.text: 1: Lotus; 2: Garland; 3: Helix; 4: Fountain; 5: Juno, Kestrel; 6: Ibis

choices.label: D
choices.text: 1: Lotus, Ibis; 2: Fountain; 3: Helix; 4: Juno; 5: Kestrel; 6: Garland

choices.label: E
choices.text: 1: Lotus, Fountain; 2: Helix; 3: Juno; 4: Kestrel; 5: Garland; 6: Ibis

explanations.correct: A places Lotus on 1 (rule 1), Fountain (1) before Garland (5), Juno (2) before Ibis (6), Helix on platform 3 in the Center wing, Juno (North) and Kestrel (Center) in different wings, Garland in the South wing (so the conditional's antecedent is false), and Fountain and Helix are on platforms 1 and 3, which are not adjacent.
explanations.B: Fountain is on platform 2 and Helix on platform 3 — adjacent platforms, violating the rule that Fountain and Helix are not displayed on adjacent platforms.
explanations.C: Garland is on platform 2, which is lower-numbered than Fountain on platform 4. This violates the requirement that Fountain be on a lower-numbered platform than Garland.
explanations.D: Ibis is on platform 1 and Juno on platform 4, so Ibis is on a lower-numbered platform than Juno. This violates the rule that Ibis must be on a higher-numbered platform than Juno.
explanations.E: Helix is on platform 2, which is in the North wing, not the Center wing. This violates the rule that Helix is displayed in the Center wing.

questions.questionStem: If Garland is displayed on platform 4, then which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fountain is displayed on platform 1.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Kestrel is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Juno is displayed on platform 2.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ibis is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Helix is displayed on platform 3.

explanations.correct: If Garland is on platform 4, then because Helix must be in the Center (platforms 3 or 4) and Fountain cannot be adjacent to Helix, and because Ibis must be after Juno, the only remaining candidate for platform 6 is Ibis. Platform 5 and 6 make up the South wing; Ibis on platform 6 places Ibis in the South wing.
explanations.A: Fountain could be on platform 1 or platform 2 depending on Helix's exact placement; this is not forced.
explanations.B: Garland on platform 4 places Garland in the Center wing, not the North wing, so the conditional rule does not trigger and Kestrel need not be in the South wing.
explanations.C: Juno could be on platform 2 or platform 3; nothing forces Juno to platform 2.
explanations.D: Correct — the position constraints force Ibis onto platform 6, which is in the South wing.
explanations.E: Helix could be on platform 3 or platform 4; however, because Garland is on platform 4, Helix must be on platform 3 only if platform 4 has no second slot for Helix. In fact Helix could share platform 4 with Garland, so Helix on 3 is not forced.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fountain and Lotus are displayed in different wings.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ibis is displayed in the Center wing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Garland is displayed on platform 3.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Juno and Helix are displayed on the same platform.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Kestrel is displayed on platform 1.

explanations.correct: In the world {Lotus:1, Fountain:1, Helix:3, Juno:3, Garland:4, Kestrel:5, Ibis:6}, Juno and Helix share platform 3. All rules hold.
explanations.A: Fountain must be on a lower-numbered platform than Garland, and Helix (Center) cannot be adjacent to Fountain. Working through the placements, Fountain must be on platform 1 or platform 2 — both of which are in the North wing, the same wing as Lotus on platform 1.
explanations.B: Ibis must come after Juno, and Juno must come after Lotus (platform 1). Given Helix occupies the Center wing and the adjacency restriction with Fountain, the remaining available slots place Ibis on platform 5 or platform 6 — the South wing — never in the Center.
explanations.C: If Garland were on platform 3, Helix would also have to be on platform 3 or 4 (Center). But Fountain must precede Garland on platform 1 or 2, and Fountain cannot be adjacent to Helix. If Helix is on 3, Fountain can only be on 1 (platform 2 is adjacent to 3), and then Juno and Ibis cannot both fit after Garland with Ibis after Juno — there is no consistent placement.
explanations.E: Lotus is on platform 1. Platform 1 already has its maximum allowance if Fountain also goes there, and Fountain must be placed early to precede Garland. Checking all solutions, Kestrel never occupies platform 1.

questions.questionStem: If Kestrel is displayed in the North wing, then which one of the following CANNOT be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Juno is displayed in the Center wing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Garland is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Garland is displayed in the North wing.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ibis is displayed on platform 6.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Helix is displayed on platform 4.

explanations.correct: If Kestrel is in the North wing, then the conditional 'If Garland is in the North wing, then Kestrel is in the South wing' is contraposed: since Kestrel is not in the South wing, Garland cannot be in the North wing.
explanations.A: Juno in the Center wing is consistent with Kestrel in the North wing (different wings, rule satisfied).
explanations.B: Garland could be placed in the South wing without any conflict with Kestrel in the North.
explanations.C: Correct — this is precisely what the contrapositive of the conditional forbids.
explanations.D: Ibis on platform 6 is consistent with many arrangements where Kestrel occupies platform 2.
explanations.E: Helix on platform 4 is consistent with Kestrel in the North wing, as the Helix location is independent of Kestrel's wing.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Lotus and Fountain are displayed on the same platform.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ibis is displayed on a higher-numbered platform than Garland.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Helix is displayed on a higher-numbered platform than Juno.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Juno is displayed on a lower-numbered platform than Ibis.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Garland is displayed in the Center wing.

explanations.correct: This is directly stated by rule 3: Juno's platform number is lower than Ibis's.
explanations.A: Fountain need not share platform 1 with Lotus; Fountain could be on platform 2.
explanations.B: Ibis could be on platform 5 and Garland on platform 6, or vice versa in some configurations — so this is not forced.
explanations.C: Juno can be on platform 3 and Helix also on platform 3; and Juno could be on a lower-numbered platform than Helix or on the same platform. Not forced.
explanations.D: Correct — directly required by the Juno-before-Ibis rule.
explanations.E: Garland could be in the Center, South, or (if Kestrel is also in the South) even the North wing — multiple options are permitted.
